scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The arrow slams into the large bicep muscle on your upper arm, the arrowhead slicing it up pretty good before coming out the other side, all red and glistening with your blood.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Bleeding] (1) and suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.GlShFJF2TpsNh1FX]{Torn Muscle (Minor)}.

Extraction will be Very Easy (+60).
